learned: 2026-10-17: Webflow page /coas, ~60 report PDFs on Webflow's CDN grouped by product (flower 3.5g, pre-roll 1g, infused pre-roll 3pk, Zero Gravity moonrock 4g); link text is the test date.
notes: Every filename starts with Webflow's 24-hex asset id and an underscore.

Filenames come in four shapes: '<YYYYMMDD>-CAPI-###-Golden Garden <Flower|Pre Roll|Infused Pre Roll|Zero Gravity Moonrock 4g> <Strain> <size>.pdf' (2026), 'X<YYMMDD>_<order>_<Strain>_<sample#>.pdf' (late 2025, lab order files), 'Golden Garden Pre Roll <Strain> 1gs.pdf', and older '<Strain> 3.5g.pdf' / '<Strain> Preroll[ <#>].pdf'.
Spellings differ from the catalog: Superboof/Super Boof, London Pound Cake/London Poundcake, Melted Strawberrys/Melted Strawberry_s; 'Buckin Rusty Preroll' and 'GG Bucking Pre COA' are Buckin Runtz.
Infused pre-rolls are the 'Live Resin Infused' line, moonrocks the 'Zero Gravity' line.
